in_sanskrit.name: Rabinder
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Servant of God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rabinder एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Rabinder is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Ravi' meaning sun and 'Bindu' meaning drop. The name symbolizes the God's grace and blessings in the form of enlightenment and wisdom. The name is suitable for a child who is destined to be a spiritual leader or a wise mentor.
